test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: **Why did Florence go to Crimea?**

options.text: To attend parties and get married there
To attend to soldiers wounded in the war there
To establish a nursing home for women there

solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. 'To attend to soldiers wounded in the war there.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The sixth sentence of the paragraph says that "Soon she was asked to go to Crimea to take charge of the wounded soldiers there."
 
• Therefore from the above sentence, we can certainly say that She was requested to travel to Crimea to care for the injured soldiers there during the war.
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 3.
